display.purpose: Page and post h1, once per page. Cooper. 1.85rem under 600px.

headline.purpose: h2 section heads and index post titles.

title.purpose: h3; h4-h6 step down at weight 600.

meta.purpose: Dates, reading time, footnotes, counts; often italic, Dust Ink.

label.purpose: Small-caps interface labels: nav, tags, pagination, TOC summary.

mono-label.purpose: Code headers, copy button, counts, handles.

shadows.name: code-card
shadows.purpose: Every pre: a code card resting on the page.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover on tag chips, Elsewhere cards, key download pill; paired with translateY(-1px).

shadows.name: slip
shadows.purpose: Torn paper slip behind hovered/current footer links.

motion.name: color-shift
motion.purpose: Link, chip, card and button colour/border/background transitions.

motion.name: slip-in
motion.purpose: Footer slip rotating in; opacity 150ms ease alongside.

components.name: Text Link

components.html: Read the flake notes first.
components.css: .ds-p { margin: 0; padding: 16px; background: #1c1915; color: #e8e2d8; font: 400 18px/1.75 "Sabon Next", Georgia, serif; } .ds-link { color: #ff9e42; text-underline-offset: 0.12em; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-link:hover { color: #ffb366; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Pill on the /tags/ index with a mono post count; lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-wrap { padding: 16px; background: #1c1915; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem 0.4rem; color: #e8e2d8; background: #242019; border: 1px solid #3b342c; border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; font: 400 18px/1.15 "Sabon Next", Georgia, serif; font-variant: small-caps; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #ff9e42; background: #1c1915; border-color: #ff9e42; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); } .ds-count { color: #9e9486; font: 400 0.75rem "PragmataPro Mono Liga", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-chip:hover .ds-count { color: #ff9e42; }

narrative.overview: The ghost light is the single lamp left burning on an empty stage. The blog is what gets written under it: warm dark paper, a book serif at a comfortable measure, and one footlight amber for everything you can touch. It is the quieter sibling of finnrut.is (The Callboard), sharing Cooper, Sabon Next, PragmataPro, one warm accent and the torn-paper footer slips. Dark is the default edition; the daylight edition is one toggle away.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark paper with chalky warm ink; never #000 or pure white.
One accent per edition: Footlight Amber (dark), Marquee Rust (light).
Cooper for titles and the drop cap; Sabon Next for reading; PragmataPro for code.
Flat tonal surfaces with hairline rules; shadows only on paper objects.
Small warm motion, removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Each edition has exactly one accent, used for interactive affordances, focus, the drop cap and the fleuron. Never a fill, body text or heading colour.

rules.name: The Ghost Light Rule
rules.body: Dark is the default edition for every new reader; light is opt-in and remembered.

rules.name: The Warm Dark Rule
rules.body: Brown-black darks and bone lights; no #000, #fff or cool greys.

rules.name: The Playbill Rule
rules.body: Cooper sets page titles, the drop cap, the ornament and the footer heading only.

rules.name: The Small Caps Label Rule
rules.body: Interface labels are Sabon small caps; mono is for literals.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Everything, including code, stays inside the 700px column.

rules.name: The Paper Casts, Words Don't Rule
rules.body: Shadows only on code cards, chips and slips.

dos: Do ship the dark edition as the first paint for every new reader.
Do define every new colour for both editions and keep both passing pa11y contrast.
Do use var(--accent) for interactive affordances and 2px focus outlines.
Do keep prose at 18px Sabon Next, 1.75 line height, inside 700px.
Do use small-caps Sabon for labels and PragmataPro for literals.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent, component gradients, or neon/terminal styling.
Don't use #000, #fff or cool greys outside print.
Don't set body text, labels or h2+ in Cooper.
Don't put shadows on text, rules or icons.
Don't break content out of the 700px column.
Don't import the main site's tilted prints, ticket stubs or playbill-scale name into posts.
